refs.text_en: But he lingered; so the men seized his hand and the hand of his wife and the hand of his two daughters, Jehovah being merciful to him, and they brought him out and set him outside the city.

refs.text_gb: 领他们出来以后，就说，逃命吧！不可回头看，也不可在平原上任何一处站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿灭。
refs.text_big5: 領他們出來以後，就說，逃命罷！不可回頭看，也不可在平原上任何一處站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿滅。
refs.text_en: And when they had brought them outside, He said, Escape for your life. Do not look behind you, neither stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the hills, lest you be destroyed.

refs.text_gb: 罗得对他们说，主啊，但愿不要如此。
refs.text_big5: 羅得對他們說，主阿，但願不要如此。
refs.text_en: And Lot said to them, May it not be so, Lord;

refs.text_gb: 你仆人已经在你眼前蒙恩，你又向我显出莫大的慈爱，保全我的性命；我没有力量逃到山上，恐怕这灾祸追上我，我便死了。
refs.text_big5: 你僕人已經在你眼前蒙恩，你又向我顯出莫大的慈愛，保全我的性命；我沒有力量逃到山上，恐怕這災禍追上我，我便死了。
refs.text_en: Even though Your servant has found favor in Your sight, and You have magnified Your lovingkindness, which You have showed to me in preserving my life; I cannot escape to the mountain, lest the disaster overtake me and I die.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，这座小城很近，容易逃到。这不是一座小城么？求你让我逃到那里，我的性命就得存活。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，這座小城很近，容易逃到。這不是一座小城麼？求你讓我逃到那裏，我的性命就得存活。
refs.text_en: Here, this city is nearby to flee to, and it is a little one. Please let me escape there-is it not a little one?-and I shall live.

refs.text_gb: 天使对他说，这事我也应允你；我不倾覆你所说的这城。
refs.text_big5: 天使對他說，這事我也應允你；我不傾覆你所說的這城。
refs.text_en: And He said to him, I now grant you this request also, that I will not overthrow the city concerning which you have spoken.

refs.text_gb: 你要快快逃到那里；因为你还没有到那里，我不能作什么。因此那城名叫琐珥。
refs.text_big5: 你要快快逃到那裏；因為你還沒有到那裏，我不能作甚麼。因此那城名叫瑣珥。
refs.text_en: Hurry, escape there; for I cannot do anything until you arrive there. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

refs.text_gb: 罗得到了琐珥，日头已经升起，照在地上。
refs.text_big5: 羅得到了瑣珥，日頭已經升起，照在地上。
refs.text_en: The sun had risen over the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

refs.text_gb: 当神毁灭平原诸城的时候，祂记念亚伯拉罕，正在倾覆罗得所住之诸城的时候，就打发罗得从倾覆之中出来。
refs.text_big5: 當神毀滅平原諸城的時候，祂記念亞伯拉罕，正在傾覆羅得所住之諸城的時候，就打發羅得從傾覆之中出來。
refs.text_en: And when God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out from the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities among which Lot dwelt.

verses.text_gb: （因为那义人定居在他们中间，看见听见不法的行为，他的义魂就天天感到痛[Cra]苦。）
verses.text_big5: （因為那義人定居在他們中間，看見聽見不法的行為，他的義魂就天天感到痛[Cra]苦。）
verses.text_en: (For that righteous man, who settled down among them, in seeing and hearing tormented his righteous soul day after day with their lawless works);
verses.text_gb_plain: （因为那义人定居在他们中间，看见听见不法的行为，他的义魂就天天感到痛苦。）
verses.text_big5_plain: （因為那義人定居在他們中間，看見聽見不法的行為，他的義魂就天天感到痛苦。）

refs.text_gb: 我的眼泪像河水流下，因为他们不守你的律法。
refs.text_big5: 我的眼淚像河水流下，因為他們不守你的律法。
refs.text_en: My eyes shed streams of water, / Because men do not keep Your law.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对他说，你去走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行一切可憎之事叹息唉哼的人，你要在他们额上画记号。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對他說，你去走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行一切可憎之事歎息唉哼的人，你要在他們額上畫記號。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to him, Pass through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the men who sigh and groan because of all the abominations that are committed in its midst.

verses.text_gb: 主知道搭救敬[Fn1]虔的人脱离试[Cra]炼，把不[Fn2]义的人留[Crb]在刑罚之下，等[Fn3]候审[Fn4]判的日[Fn5][Crc]子；
verses.text_big5: 主知道搭救敬[Fn1]虔的人脫離試[Cra]煉，把不[Fn2]義的人留[Crb]在刑罰之下，等[Fn3]候審[Fn4]判的日[Fn5][Crc]子；
verses.text_en: The Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of trial and how to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
verses.text_gb_plain: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脱离试炼，把不义的人留在刑罚之下，等候审判的日子；
verses.text_big5_plain: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脫離試煉，把不義的人留在刑罰之下，等候審判的日子；

footnotes.zh: 指那些像挪亚和罗得(5，7)过敬虔生活的人，与过不敬虔生活的人(6)相对。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指那些像挪亞和羅得（5，7）過敬虔生活的人，與過不敬虔生活的人（6）相對。
footnotes.en: 2:9 1 godly Those who, like Noah and Lot (vv. 5, 7), live a godly life, in contrast to those who live an ungodly life (v. 6).

footnotes.zh: 指那些随从不法之人的淫行，过不义生活的人，像挪亚时代以及所多玛、蛾摩拉城的人(5～7)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指那些隨從不法之人的淫行，過不義生活的人，像挪亞時代以及所多瑪、蛾摩拉城的人。（5～7。）
footnotes.en: 2:9 2 unrighteous People who, like those in Noah's time and those in Sodom and Gomorrah (vv. 5-7), live an unrighteous life, in the licentious manner of the lawless.

footnotes.zh: 或，直到。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，直到。
footnotes.en: 2:9 3 for Or, until.

footnotes.zh: 见彼前一17注2二段。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見彼前一17註2二段。
footnotes.en: 2:9 4 day The day of the final judgment, the judgment at the great white throne (see note 2 Pet. 3:7 4 , note 2 Pet. 2:4 4 , and note Jude 1:6 4 ).

footnotes.zh: 指白色大宝座之末后审判的日子(见三7注5，二4注4，犹6注4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指白色大寶座之末後審判的日子。（見三7註5，二4註4，猶6註4。）
footnotes.en: 2:9 5 judgment See note 1 Pet. 1:17 2 , par. 2.

refs.text_gb: 亲爱的，有火炼的试验临到你们，为要试炼你们，不要以为奇怪，似乎是遭遇非常的事，
refs.text_big5: 親愛的，有火煉的試驗臨到你們，為要試煉你們，不要以為奇怪，似乎是遭遇非常的事，
refs.text_en: Beloved, do not think that the fiery ordeal among you, coming to you for a trial, is strange, as if it were a strange thing happening to you;

refs.text_gb: 即便如此，我们所事奉的神，也能将我们从烈火的窑中救出来；王啊，祂必救我们脱离你的手。
refs.text_big5: 即便如此，我們所事奉的神，也能將我們從烈火的窯中救出來；王阿，祂必救我們脫離你的手。
refs.text_en: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the blazing furnace of fire, and He will deliver us out of your hand, O king.

refs.text_gb: 就是天使犯了罪，神也没有宽容，反而把他们丢在他他拉里，交在幽暗坑中，拘留着等候审判；
refs.text_big5: 就是天使犯了罪，神也沒有寬容，反而把他們丟在他他拉裏，交在幽暗坑中，拘留著等候審判；
refs.text_en: For if God did not spare the angels who sinned but delivered them to gloomy pits, having cast them down to Tartarus, they being kept for judgment;

refs.text_gb: 但现在的诸天和地，还是凭着同样的话保留着，直留到不敬虔的人受审判遭毁坏的日子，给火焚烧。
refs.text_big5: 但現在的諸天和地，還是憑著同樣的話保留著，直留到不敬虔的人受審判遭毀壞的日子，給火焚燒。
refs.text_en: But the heavens and the earth now, by the same word, have been stored up for fire, being kept unto the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

verses.text_gb: 对那[Fn1]些放纵污[Cra]秽的情[Crb]欲，随从肉体，并轻慢主[Fn2]治者的人，更是如此。他们胆大任[Fn3][Crc]性，毁谤在[Fn4]尊位的也不战惊；
verses.text_big5: 對那[Fn1]些放縱污[Cra]穢的情[Crb]慾，隨從肉體，並輕慢主[Fn2]治者的人，更是如此。他們膽大任[Fn3][Crc]性，毀謗在[Fn4]尊位的也不戰驚；
verses.text_en: And especially those who go after the flesh in the lust for defilement and despise lordship. Daring, self-willed, they do not tremble while reviling dignities;
verses.text_gb_plain: 对那些放纵污秽的情欲，随从肉体，并轻慢主治者的人，更是如此。他们胆大任性，毁谤在尊位的也不战惊；
verses.text_big5_plain: 對那些放縱污穢的情慾，隨從肉體，並輕慢主治者的人，更是如此。他們膽大任性，毀謗在尊位的也不戰驚；

footnotes.zh: 从这里到本章末了，又回头暴露1～3节所暴露过的假教师和随从他们的人。在神行政的对付里，他们特别要留在刑罚之下，等候审判的日子，因为他们随从肉体，为着宴乐放纵污秽的情欲和腐败的奢侈，又轻慢主的行政，背叛主的权柄(10，13～14，18)。因此，他们如同后列的人：没有理性的畜类(12)；神所珍爱之信徒的斑点和瑕疵(13)；为不义之工价离弃正路的巴兰(15)；无水的井和暴风催逼的雾气(17～19)；里外都被玷污的狗和猪(20～22)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從這裏到本章末了，又回頭暴露1～3節所暴露過的假教師和隨從他們的人。在神行政的對付裏，他們特別要留在刑罰之下，等候審判的日子，因為他們隨從肉體，為著宴樂放縱污穢的情慾和腐敗的奢侈，又輕慢主的行政，背叛主的權柄。（10，13～14，18。）因此，他們如同後列的人：沒有理性的畜類；（12；）神所珍愛之信徒的斑點和瑕疵；（13；）為不義之工價離棄正路的巴蘭；（15；）無水的井和暴風催逼的霧氣；（17～19；）裏外都被玷污的狗和豬。（20～22。）
footnotes.en: 2:10 1 those From here to the end of the chapter the exposure returns to the false teachers and their followers, who were exposed initially in vv. 1-3. In God's governmental dealing they, especially, will be kept under punishment for the day of judgment because they go after the flesh, indulging for pleasure in the lust for defilement and in corrupting luxury, and despise the Lord's government, rebelling against the Lord's authority (vv. 10, 13-14, 18). Thus, they become persons who are like 1) animals without reason (v. 12); 2) spots and blemishes among the believers, who are God's treasure (v. 13); 3) Balaam, forsaking the straight way for unrighteous gain (v. 15); 4) springs without water and mists driven by a storm (vv. 17-19); 5) dogs and sows, becoming defiled both inwardly and outwardly (vv. 20-22).

footnotes.zh: 概指一切有权治理者，当然包括神所膏而设立的主基督。祂是神圣行政、管理和权柄的中心(徒二36，弗一21，西一16)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 概指一切有權治理者，當然包括神所膏而設立的主基督。祂是神聖行政、管理和權柄的中心。（徒二36，弗一21，西一16。）
footnotes.en: 2:10 2 lordship Referring, in general, to all those who have authority to rule, including, of course, the Lord Christ, who was anointed and set up by God and who is the center of the divine government, dominion, and authority (Acts 2:36; Eph. 1:21; Col. 1:16).

footnotes.zh: 即自娱自乐，为自己寻求快乐。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即自娛自樂，為自己尋求快樂。
footnotes.en: 2:10 3 self Self-pleasing, seeking pleasure for self.

footnotes.zh: 直译，荣耀(复数)。概指有权有位的天使和世人(11，犹9，多三1～2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，榮耀（複數）。概指有權有位的天使和世人。（11，猶9，多三1～2。）
footnotes.en: 2:10 4 dignities Lit., glories; referring generally to both angels and men in power and authority (v. 11; Jude 1:9; Titus 3:1-2).

refs.text_gb: 倘若他们因认识主和救主耶稣基督，得以逃脱世上的污秽，却又在其中被缠住制伏，他们末后的景况，就比先前更不好了。
refs.text_big5: 倘若他們因認識主和救主耶穌基督，得以逃脫世上的污穢，卻又在其中被纏住制伏，他們末後的景況，就比先前更不好了。
refs.text_en: For if, having escaped the defilements of the world by the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ but having again been entangled in these, they are defeated, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

refs.text_gb: 所以亲爱的，我们既有这些应许，就当洁净自己，除去肉身和灵一切的玷污，敬畏神，以成全圣别。
refs.text_big5: 所以親愛的，我們既有這些應許，就當潔淨自己，除去肉身和靈一切的玷污，敬畏神，以成全聖別。
refs.text_en: Therefore since we have these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and of spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

refs.text_gb: 好使你们不再从人的情欲，只从神的旨意，在肉身中度余下的光阴。
refs.text_big5: 好使你們不再從人的情慾，只從神的旨意，在肉身中度餘下的光陰。
refs.text_en: No longer to live the rest of the time in the flesh in the lusts of men, but in the will of God.

refs.text_gb: 因为凡世界上的事，就是肉体的情欲、眼目的情欲、并今生的骄傲，都不是出于父，乃是出于世界。
refs.text_big5: 因為凡世界上的事，就是肉體的情慾、眼目的情慾、並今生的驕傲，都不是出於父，乃是出於世界。
refs.text_en: Because all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vainglory of life, is not of the Father but is of the world.

refs.text_gb: 因为监督是神的管家，必须无可指责，不任性，不暴躁，不醉酒滋事，不打人，不贪卑鄙的利益；
refs.text_big5: 因為監督是神的管家，必須無可指責，不任性，不暴躁，不醉酒滋事，不打人，不貪卑鄙的利益；
refs.text_en: For the overseer must be unreprovable as a steward of God, not self-willed, not quick tempered, not an excessive drinker, not a striker, not greedy for base gain;

verses.text_gb: 就是天[Fn1]使，虽然力量、权能更大，还不[Fn2]用毁谤的判辞，在主面前告他们。
verses.text_big5: 就是天[Fn1]使，雖然力量、權能更大，還不[Fn2]用毀謗的判辭，在主面前告他們。
verses.text_en: Whereas angels, though they are greater in strength and power, do not bring a reviling judgment against them before the Lord.
verses.text_gb_plain: 就是天使，虽然力量、权能更大，还不用毁谤的判辞，在主面前告他们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 就是天使，雖然力量、權能更大，還不用毀謗的判辭，在主面前告他們。

footnotes.en: 2:11 1 them Angels and them, referring to dignities in v. 10, are mentioned here in a general way; but in Jude 1:9, regarding the same case, the archangel Michael and the devil are singled out.

footnotes.zh: 这是守住在神行政中权柄的等次。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是守住在神行政中權柄的等次。
footnotes.en: 2:11 2 do This is to keep the order of authority in God's government.

verses.text_gb: 但这[Cra]些人好像没[Fn1]有理性的畜[Fn2]类，生来本性是为[Fn3]着被捉拿并毁[Fn4]坏的；他们毁谤所不晓得的事，正在败坏人的时候，自己必遭毁[Fn5]坏；
verses.text_big5: 但這[Cra]些人好像沒[Fn1]有理性的畜[Fn2]類，生來本性是為[Fn3]著被捉拿並毀[Fn4]壞的；他們毀謗所不曉得的事，正在敗壞人的時候，自己必遭毀[Fn5]壞；
verses.text_en: But these, like animals without reason, born natural for capture and destruction, reviling in things of which they are ignorant, will also in their corrupting of others be destroyed;
verses.text_gb_plain: 但这些人好像没有理性的畜类，生来本性是为着被捉拿并毁坏的；他们毁谤所不晓得的事，正在败坏人的时候，自己必遭毁坏；
verses.text_big5_plain: 但這些人好像沒有理性的畜類，生來本性是為著被捉拿並毀壞的；他們毀謗所不曉得的事，正在敗壞人的時候，自己必遭毀壞；

footnotes.zh: 没有理性，指对道德的问题没有感觉。人里面最高的感觉，乃是人的灵，有良心为其主要部分。人堕落以后，良心管治人活在神的行政之下。有些人因着否认神，放弃自己良心的知觉(罗一23～32)，就丧尽了所有的感觉(弗四19与注)。第一世纪的异端者，就像古代犹太教的撒都该人(徒二三8)，和今天基督教的摩登派，都属这一类。他们否认主到了极点，以致良心被烙，失去知觉(提前四2与注3)，变成好像没有灵一样(犹10，参19)。因此，他们好像没有理性的畜类，好像靠本能而活的造物，生来本性就是要因情欲给撒但那毁坏人者捉拿，使他们受败坏以致遭毁坏。这里所描绘的给我们看见，堕落的人竟会像没有理性的畜类！
footnotes.zh_big5: 沒有理性，指對道德的問題沒有感覺。人裏面最高的感覺，乃是人的靈，有良心為其主要部分。人墮落以後，良心管治人活在神的行政之下。有些人因著否認神，放棄自己良心的知覺，（羅一23～32，）就喪盡了所有的感覺。（弗四19與註。）第一世紀的異端者，就像古代猶太教的撒都該人，（徒二三8，）和今天基督教的摩登派，都屬這一類。他們否認主到了極點，以致良心被烙，失去知覺，（提前四2與註3，）變成好像沒有靈一樣。（猶10，參猶19。）因此，他們好像沒有理性的畜類，好像靠本能而活的造物，生來本性就是要因情慾給撒但那毀壞人者捉拿，使他們受敗壞以致遭毀壞。這裏所描繪的給我們看見，墮落的人竟會像沒有理性的畜類！
footnotes.en: 2:12 1 animals Lit., living creatures (including man); indicating men who are living like animals.

footnotes.zh: 直译，活物(包括人)。指明人生活像畜类一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，活物（包括人）。指明人生活像畜類一樣。
footnotes.en: 2:12 2 without Or, irrational, having no sense regarding moral issues. The highest sense within man is his spirit, of which the conscience is the leading part. Since man's fall, the conscience has governed man under God's government. Some men are past feeling (Eph. 4:19 and note Eph. 4:19 1 ), having given up the consciousness of their conscience through their denial of God (Rom. 1:23-32). The first century heretics, such as the Sadducees in ancient Judaism (Acts 23:8), and the modernists in today's Christianity are all in this category. They have denied the Lord to the uttermost so that their conscience is seared and has lost its consciousness (1 Tim. 4:2 and note 1 Tim. 4:2 2 ), as if they do not even have a spirit (Jude 1:10, cf. Jude 1:19). Thus, they become like animals without reason, like creatures of instinct, born natural to be captured, through their lust, by Satan, the destroyer of man, that they may be corrupted unto destruction. The portrayal here shows us that fallen men can be like animals without reason!

footnotes.zh: 直译，达到。指他们的定命就是被捉拿以致遭毁坏，成为败坏的奴仆(19)。我们借神圣的供备(一3～4)得着生命的供应，就能逃脱这带来毁坏的败坏。见1注5第三点。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，達到。指他們的定命就是被捉拿以致遭毀壞，成為敗壞的奴僕。（19。）我們藉神聖的供備（一3～4）得著生命的供應，就能逃脫這帶來毀壞的敗壞。見1註5第三點。
footnotes.en: 2:12 3 for Lit., unto; indicating that they are destined to be captured for destruction, to be made slaves of corruption (v. 19). By the supply of life through the divine provision (2 Pet. 1:3-4) we are able to escape this corruption that brings in destruction. See note 2 Pet. 2:1 5 , point 3.

footnotes.zh: 原文二次毁坏均同败坏。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文二次毀壞均同敗壞。
footnotes.en: 2:12 4 destruction The same Greek word as for corruption.

footnotes.zh: 指由败坏所致之毁坏。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指由敗壞所致之毀壞。
footnotes.en: 2:12 5 destroyed The same Greek word as for corrupted, referring to destruction caused by corruption.

verses.text_gb: 行[Fn1]的不义，就得了不[Fn2]义的工[Cra]价；他们以白昼奢侈为宴[Crb]乐，成为斑[Fn3][Crc]点和瑕疵，与你们一同坐[Crd]席，以自己的诡诈为奢乐；
verses.text_big5: 行[Fn1]的不義，就得了不[Fn2]義的工[Cra]價；他們以白晝奢侈為宴[Crb]樂，成為斑[Fn3][Crc]點和瑕疵，與你們一同坐[Crd]席，以自己的詭詐為奢樂；
verses.text_en: Suffering unrighteousness as the wages of unrighteousness; considering luxury in the day to be pleasure; spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceits while feasting together with you;
verses.text_gb_plain: 行的不义，就得了不义的工价；他们以白昼奢侈为宴乐，成为斑点和瑕疵，与你们一同坐席，以自己的诡诈为奢乐；
verses.text_big5_plain: 行的不義，就得了不義的工價；他們以白晝奢侈為宴樂，成為斑點和瑕疵，與你們一同坐席，以自己的詭詐為奢樂；

footnotes.zh: “行的不义，就得了不义的工价，”有些古卷作，得了不义的工价。
footnotes.zh_big5: “行的不義，就得了不義的工價，”有些古卷作，得了不義的工價。
footnotes.en: 2:13 1 Suffering Some MSS read, Receiving the wages of unrighteousness.

footnotes.zh: 即不义之作为的工价。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即不義之作為的工價。
footnotes.en: 2:13 2 wages I.e., wages of unrighteous doing.

footnotes.zh: 放纵情欲的异端者，对于是神珍宝的真信徒，就像斑点、瑕疵之于宝石一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: 放縱情慾的異端者，對於是神珍寶的真信徒，就像斑點、瑕疵之於寶石一樣。
footnotes.en: 2:13 3 spots The lust-indulging heretics are to genuine believers, who are God's treasure, as spots and blemishes are to precious gems.

refs.text_gb: 离弃正路而走迷了，随从比珥之子巴兰的路；巴兰曾经贪爱不义的工价，
refs.text_big5: 離棄正路而走迷了，隨從比珥之子巴蘭的路；巴蘭曾經貪愛不義的工價，
refs.text_en: Forsaking the straight way, they have gone astray, following the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness

refs.text_gb: 这人用不义的工价买了一块田，以后他倒头坠下，肚腹迸裂，肠子都流出来。
refs.text_big5: 這人用不義的工價買了一塊田，以後他倒頭墜下，肚腹迸裂，腸子都流出來。
refs.text_en: (Now this man acquired a piece of land with the wages of unrighteousness; and falling headlong, he burst in the middle, and all his inward parts gushed out.

refs.text_gb: 那落在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，走开以后，被今生的思虑、钱财和宴乐全然挤住了，便结不出成熟的子粒来。
refs.text_big5: 那落在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，走開以後，被今生的思慮、錢財和宴樂全然擠住了，便結不出成熟的子粒來。
refs.text_en: And that which fell into the thorns, these are those who heard and, going away, are utterly choked by anxieties and riches and pleasures of this life, and do not bring any fruit to maturity.

refs.text_gb: 因为我们从前也是无知、悖逆、受迷惑的，给各样的私欲和宴乐作奴仆，将生命时光耗费于恶毒和嫉妒，是可恨的，又是彼此相恨。
refs.text_big5: 因為我們從前也是無知、悖逆、受迷惑的，給各樣的私慾和宴樂作奴僕，將生命時光耗費於惡毒和嫉妒，是可恨的，又是彼此相恨。
refs.text_en: For we also were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving as slaves various lusts and pleasures, spending our lives in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

refs.text_gb: 你们求也无所得，是因为你们妄求，为要耗费在你们的宴乐中。
refs.text_big5: 你們求也無所得，是因為你們妄求，為要耗費在你們的宴樂中。
refs.text_en: You ask and do not receive because you ask evilly that you may spend it on your pleasures.

refs.text_gb: 你们活在地上奢华宴乐；当宰杀的日子，竟养肥了你们的心。
refs.text_big5: 你們活在地上奢華宴樂；當宰殺的日子，竟養肥了你們的心。
refs.text_en: You have lived luxuriously on the earth and have given yourselves to pleasure; you have nourished your hearts in a day of slaughter.

refs.text_gb: 所以，亲爱的，你们既期待这些事，就当殷勤，得在平安中给主看为无斑点、无瑕疵的；
refs.text_big5: 所以，親愛的，你們既期待這些事，就當殷勤，得在平安中給主看為無斑點、無瑕疵的；
refs.text_en: Therefore, beloved, since you expect these things, be diligent to be found by Him in peace without spot and without blemish;

refs.text_gb: 祂好献给自己，作荣耀的召会，没有斑点、皱纹、或任何这类的病，好使她成为圣别、没有瑕疵。
refs.text_big5: 祂好獻給自己，作榮耀的召會，沒有斑點、皺紋、或任何這類的病，好使她成為聖別、沒有瑕疵。
refs.text_en: That He might present the church to Himself glorious, not having spot or wrinkle or any such things, but that she would be holy and without blemish.

verses.text_gb: 满眼是淫[Fn1][Cra]色，止[Crb]不住犯罪；引[Crc]诱那不[Crd]坚固的人[Fn2]，心中习惯了贪[Cre]婪，是被咒[Crf]诅的儿[Crg]女；
verses.text_big5: 滿眼是淫[Fn1][Cra]色，止[Crb]不住犯罪；引[Crc]誘那不[Crd]堅固的人[Fn2]，心中習慣了貪[Cre]婪，是被咒[Crf]詛的兒[Crg]女；
verses.text_en: Having eyes full of adultery and not ceasing from sin; enticing unstable souls, having a heart exercised for covetousness, children of curse.
verses.text_gb_plain: 满眼是淫色，止不住犯罪；引诱那不坚固的人，心中习惯了贪婪，是被咒诅的儿女；
verses.text_big5_plain: 滿眼是淫色，止不住犯罪；引誘那不堅固的人，心中習慣了貪婪，是被咒詛的兒女；

footnotes.zh: 直译，淫妇。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，淫婦。
footnotes.en: 2:14 1 adultery Lit., an adulteress.

footnotes.zh: 直译，魂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，魂。

refs.text_gb: 你们这些淫乱的人，岂不知与世界为友，就是与神为敌么？所以凡想要与世界为友的，就成了神的仇敌。
refs.text_big5: 你們這些淫亂的人，豈不知與世界為友，就是與神為敵麼？所以凡想要與世界為友的，就成了神的仇敵。
refs.text_en: Adulteresses, do you not know that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? Therefore whoever determines to be a friend of the world is constituted an enemy of God.

refs.text_gb: 基督既在肉身受过苦，你们也当用同样的心思武装自己，（因为在肉身受过苦的，就与罪断绝了；）
refs.text_big5: 基督既在肉身受過苦，你們也當用同樣的心思武裝自己，（因為在肉身受過苦的，就與罪斷絕了；）
refs.text_en: Since Christ therefore has suffered in the flesh, you also arm yourselves with the same mind (because he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin),

refs.text_gb: 绝对不可！我们这向罪死了的人，岂可仍在罪中活着？
refs.text_big5: 絕對不可！我們這向罪死了的人，豈可仍在罪中活著？
refs.text_en: Absolutely not! We who have died to sin, how shall we still live in it?

refs.text_gb: 因为他们说虚妄矜夸的大话，凭肉体的情欲，用邪荡的事，引诱那些刚能逃脱在错谬中生活者的人，
refs.text_big5: 因為他們說虛妄矜誇的大話，憑肉體的情慾，用邪蕩的事，引誘那些剛能逃脫在錯謬中生活者的人，
refs.text_en: For uttering great swelling words of vanity, they entice by lusts of the flesh, with licentiousness, those who are barely escaping from them who live in error;

refs.text_gb: 但各人被试诱，乃是被自己的私欲勾引诱惑的；
refs.text_big5: 但各人被試誘，乃是被自己的私慾勾引誘惑的；
refs.text_en: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away and enticed by his own lusts;

refs.text_gb: 他在一切的信上也都是讲论这些事；信中有些是难以明白的，那无学识不坚固的人曲解，如曲解其余的经书一样，就自取毁坏。
refs.text_big5: 他在一切的信上也都是講論這些事；信中有些是難以明白的，那無學識不堅固的人曲解，如曲解其餘的經書一樣，就自取毀壞。
refs.text_en: As also in all his letters, speaking in them concerning these things, in which some things are hard to understand, which the unlearned and unstable twist, as also the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.

refs.text_gb: 他们因着贪婪，要用捏造的言语，在你们身上取利；他们的审判，自古以来就不松懈，他们的毁坏也必速速来到。
refs.text_big5: 他們因著貪婪，要用捏造的言語，在你們身上取利；他們的審判，自古以來就不鬆懈，他們的毀壞也必速速來到。
refs.text_en: And in covetousness, with fabricated words, they will make merchandise of you, for whom the judgment of old is not idle, and their destruction does not slumber.

refs.text_gb: 为我弟兄，我肉身的亲人，我宁愿自己被咒诅，与基督分离。
refs.text_big5: 為我弟兄，我肉身的親人，我寧願自己被咒詛，與基督分離。
refs.text_en: For I could wish that I myself were a curse, separated from Christ for my brothers, my kinsmen according to the flesh,

refs.text_gb: 若有人不爱主，他就是可咒可诅的。主来了！
refs.text_big5: 若有人不愛主，他就是可咒可詛的。主來了！
refs.text_en: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be accursed! The Lord comes!

refs.text_gb: 但即使是我们，或是从天上来的使者，若在我们所传给你们的福音之外，另传一个福音给你们，他就该受咒诅。
refs.text_big5: 但即使是我們，或是從天上來的使者，若在我們所傳給你們的福音之外，另傳一個福音給你們，他就該受咒詛。
refs.text_en: But if even we or an angel out of heaven should announce to you a gospel beyond that which we have announced to you, let him be accursed.

refs.text_gb: 我们先前说过，现在我再说，若有人在你们所领受的之外，另传一个福音给你们，他就该受咒诅。
refs.text_big5: 我們先前說過，現在我再說，若有人在你們所領受的之外，另傳一個福音給你們，他就該受咒詛。
refs.text_en: As we have said before, now also I say again, If anyone announces to you a gospel beyond that which you have received, let him be accursed.

refs.text_gb: 我们众人从前也都在他们中间，在我们肉体的私欲里，行事为人，行肉体和思念所意欲的，生来就是可怒的儿女，和其余的人一样；
refs.text_big5: 我們眾人從前也都在他們中間，在我們肉體的私慾裏，行事為人，行肉體和思念所意欲的，生來就是可怒的兒女，和其餘的人一樣；
refs.text_en: Among whom we also all conducted ourselves once in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the thoughts, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest;

verses.text_gb: 离弃正[Fn1]路而走[Cra]迷了，随[Fn2]从比珥之子巴[Fn3][Crb]兰的路；巴兰曾经贪爱不义的工[Crc]价，
verses.text_big5: 離棄正[Fn1]路而走[Cra]迷了，隨[Fn2]從比珥之子巴[Fn3][Crb]蘭的路；巴蘭曾經貪愛不義的工[Crc]價，
verses.text_en: Forsaking the straight way, they have gone astray, following the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness
verses.text_gb_plain: 离弃正路而走迷了，随从比珥之子巴兰的路；巴兰曾经贪爱不义的工价，
verses.text_big5_plain: 離棄正路而走迷了，隨從比珥之子巴蘭的路；巴蘭曾經貪愛不義的工價，

footnotes.zh: 正路，就如真理的路(2与注2)，义路(21与注1)，就是过正直的生活，没有弯曲偏斜，没有不义。
footnotes.zh_big5: 正路，就如真理的路，（2與註2，）義路，（21與註1，）就是過正直的生活，沒有彎曲偏斜，沒有不義。
footnotes.en: 2:15 1 straight To take the straight way, such as the way of the truth (v. 2 and note 2 Pet. 2:2 2 ) and the way of righteousness (v. 21 and note 2 Pet. 2:21 1 ), is to live an upright life without crookedness and bias, without unrighteousness.

footnotes.zh: 直译，紧紧跟随。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，緊緊跟隨。
footnotes.en: 2:15 2 following Lit., following out.

footnotes.zh: 巴兰是外邦的真申言者，不是假申言者，却是贪爱不义之工价的(民二二5，7，申二三4，尼十三2，启二14)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 巴蘭是外邦的真申言者，不是假申言者，卻是貪愛不義之工價的。（民二二5，7，申二三4，尼十三2，啟二14。）
footnotes.en: 2:15 3 Balaam Balaam was a genuine Gentile prophet, not a false one, but he loved the wages of unrighteousness (Num. 22:5, 7; Deut. 23:4; Neh. 13:2; Rev. 2:14).

refs.text_gb: 好使以色列家不再走迷离开我，不再因自己一切的罪过玷污自己，只要作我的子民，我作他们的神，这是主耶和华说的。
refs.text_big5: 好使以色列家不再走迷離開我，不再因自己一切的罪過玷污自己，只要作我的子民，我作他們的神，這是主耶和華說的。
refs.text_en: That the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me and may no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions, but that they may be My people and I may be their God, declares the Lord Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 他差遣使者往大河边的毗夺去，到比珥的儿子巴兰本乡那里，召巴兰来，说，有一民从埃及出来，遮满这地，住在我的对面。
refs.text_big5: 他差遣使者往大河邊的毘奪去，到比珥的兒子巴蘭本鄉那裏，召巴蘭來，說，有一民從埃及出來，遮滿這地，住在我的對面。
refs.text_en: And he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, There is a people here who have come out from Egypt; now they cover the surface of the land and have settled over against me.

refs.text_gb: 摩押的长老和米甸的长老，手里拿着占卜的礼金，到了巴兰那里，将巴勒的话告诉他。
refs.text_big5: 摩押的長老和米甸的長老，手裏拿著占卜的禮金，到了巴蘭那裏，將巴勒的話告訴他。
refs.text_en: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with fees for divination in their hand, and they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.

refs.text_gb: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因他们雇了米所波大米的毗夺人比珥的儿子巴兰，来和你们作对，咒诅你们。
refs.text_big5: 因為你們出埃及的時候，他們沒有拿食物和水在路上迎接你們，又因他們雇了米所波大米的毘奪人比珥的兒子巴蘭，來和你們作對，咒詛你們。
refs.text_en: Because they did not come to meet you with bread and water in the way when you were coming out of Egypt, and because they hired Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia against you, to curse you.

refs.text_gb: 因为他们没有拿食物和水来迎接以色列人，反而雇了巴兰咒诅他们，但我们的神使那咒诅变为祝福。
refs.text_big5: 因為他們沒有拿食物和水來迎接以色列人，反而雇了巴蘭咒詛他們，但我們的神使那咒詛變為祝福。
refs.text_en: For they did not meet the children of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; yet our God turned the curse into a blessing.

refs.text_gb: 然而有几件事我要责备你，因为在你那里，有人持守巴兰的教训；这巴兰曾教导巴勒，将绊脚石放在以色列子孙面前，叫他们吃祭偶像之物，并且行淫乱。
refs.text_big5: 然而有幾件事我要責備你，因為在你那裏，有人持守巴蘭的教訓；這巴蘭曾教導巴勒，將絆腳石放在以色列子孫面前，叫他們喫祭偶像之物，並且行淫亂。
refs.text_en: But I have a few things against you, that you have some there who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat idol sacrifices and to commit fornication.

refs.text_gb: 行的不义，就得了不义的工价；他们以白昼奢侈为宴乐，成为斑点和瑕疵，与你们一同坐席，以自己的诡诈为奢乐；
refs.text_big5: 行的不義，就得了不義的工價；他們以白晝奢侈為宴樂，成為斑點和瑕疵，與你們一同坐席，以自己的詭詐為奢樂；
refs.text_en: Suffering unrighteousness as the wages of unrighteousness; considering luxury in the day to be pleasure; spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceits while feasting together with you;

verses.text_gb: 为自己的过犯且受了责备；那不能说话的驴[Fn1][Cra]，竟以人声发言，拦阻了申言者的狂妄。
verses.text_big5: 為自己的過犯且受了責備；那不能說話的驢[Fn1][Cra]，竟以人聲發言，攔阻了申言者的狂妄。
verses.text_en: But had reproof for his own transgression: a dumb beast of burden, uttering with a man's voice, restrained the madness of the prophet.
verses.text_gb_plain: 为自己的过犯且受了责备；那不能说话的驴，竟以人声发言，拦阻了申言者的狂妄。
verses.text_big5_plain: 為自己的過犯且受了責備；那不能說話的驢，竟以人聲發言，攔阻了申言者的狂妄。

footnotes.zh: 直译，负重的牲口。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，負重的牲口。
footnotes.en: 2:16 1 beast I.e., donkey.

refs.text_gb: 巴兰早晨起来，备上驴，和摩押的首领一同去了。
refs.text_big5: 巴蘭早晨起來，備上驢，和摩押的首領一同去了。
refs.text_en: And Balaam rose up in the morning and saddled his donkey and went with the rulers of Moab.

refs.text_gb: 神因他去就发怒；耶和华的使者站在路上抵挡他。他骑着驴，有两个仆人跟随他。
refs.text_big5: 神因他去就發怒；耶和華的使者站在路上抵擋他。他騎著驢，有兩個僕人跟隨他。
refs.text_en: And God's anger was kindled because he was going, and the Angel of Jehovah took His stand in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

refs.text_gb: 驴看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，就从路上转开，跨进田间；巴兰便打驴，要叫它转回路上。
refs.text_big5: 驢看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裏有拔出來的刀，就從路上轉開，跨進田間；巴蘭便打驢，要叫牠轉回路上。
refs.text_en: And when the donkey saw the Angel of Jehovah standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand, the donkey turned aside out of the way and went into the field. And Balaam struck the donkey to turn her back into the way.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的使者就站在葡萄园间的窄路上，这边有墙，那边也有墙。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的使者就站在葡萄園間的窄路上，這邊有牆，那邊也有牆。
refs.text_en: Then the Angel of Jehovah stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on this side and a wall on that side.

refs.text_gb: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就贴靠墙，将巴兰的脚挤伤了；于是巴兰又打驴。
refs.text_big5: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就貼靠牆，將巴蘭的腳擠傷了；於是巴蘭又打驢。
refs.text_en: And when the donkey saw the Angel of Jehovah, she pressed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall. So he struck her again.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的使者又往前去，站在狭窄之处，左右都无路可以转折。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的使者又往前去，站在狹窄之處，左右都無路可以轉折。
refs.text_en: And the Angel of Jehovah went further and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right or to the left.

refs.text_gb: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就卧在巴兰底下；巴兰就发怒，用杖打驴。
refs.text_big5: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就臥在巴蘭底下；巴蘭就發怒，用杖打驢。
refs.text_en: And when the donkey saw the Angel of Jehovah, she lay down under Balaam. Then Balaam's anger was kindled, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华开了驴的口，驴对巴兰说，我向你行了什么，你竟打我这三次呢？
refs.text_big5: 耶和華開了驢的口，驢對巴蘭說，我向你行了甚麼，你竟打我這三次呢？
refs.text_en: And Jehovah opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?

refs.text_gb: 巴兰对驴说，因为你戏弄我，我若手中有刀，早就把你杀了。
refs.text_big5: 巴蘭對驢說，因為你戲弄我，我若手中有刀，早就把你殺了。
refs.text_en: And Balaam said to the donkey, Because you have mocked me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would have killed you by now.

refs.text_gb: 驴对巴兰说，我不是你从小时直到今日所骑的驴么？我素常向你这样行过么？巴兰说，没有。
refs.text_big5: 驢對巴蘭說，我不是你從小時直到今日所騎的驢麼？我素常向你這樣行過麼？巴蘭說，沒有。
refs.text_en: And the donkey said to Balaam, Am I not your donkey on which you have ridden all your life to this day? Have I ever been accustomed to do so to you? And he said, No.

verses.text_gb: 这些人是无[Fn1][Cra]水的井，是暴风催逼的雾气，有黑[Fn2]暗的幽[Crb]冥为他们存留。
verses.text_big5: 這些人是無[Fn1][Cra]水的井，是暴風催逼的霧氣，有黑[Fn2]暗的幽[Crb]冥為他們存留。
verses.text_en: These are springs without water and mists driven by a storm, for whom the gloom of darkness is kept.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这些人是无水的井，是暴风催逼的雾气，有黑暗的幽冥为他们存留。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這些人是無水的井，是暴風催逼的霧氣，有黑暗的幽冥為他們存留。

footnotes.zh: 干枯的异端教师是无水的井，是暴风催逼的雾气，也就是被风飘荡、没有雨水的云彩(犹12)，毫无生命应付干渴人的需要。
footnotes.zh_big5: 乾枯的異端教師是無水的井，是暴風催逼的霧氣，也就是被風飄蕩、沒有雨水的雲彩，（猶12，）毫無生命應付乾渴人的需要。
footnotes.en: 2:17 1 springs The dried up heretical teachers are springs without water and mists driven by a storm, that is, waterless clouds being carried off by winds (Jude 1:12), having nothing of life to meet the need of the thirsty ones.

footnotes.zh: 这也是神行政的对付。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這也是神行政的對付。
footnotes.en: 2:17 2 gloom This also is God's governmental dealing.

verses.text_gb: 因为他们说虚[Cra]妄矜[Crb]夸的大话，凭肉体的情[Crc]欲，用邪荡的事，引[Crd]诱那些刚能逃[Cre]脱在错谬中生[Fn1]活者的人，
verses.text_big5: 因為他們說虛[Cra]妄矜[Crb]誇的大話，憑肉體的情[Crc]慾，用邪蕩的事，引[Crd]誘那些剛能逃[Cre]脫在錯謬中生[Fn1]活者的人，
verses.text_en: For uttering great swelling words of vanity, they entice by lusts of the flesh, with licentiousness, those who are barely escaping from them who live in error;
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为他们说虚妄矜夸的大话，凭肉体的情欲，用邪荡的事，引诱那些刚能逃脱在错谬中生活者的人，
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為他們說虛妄矜誇的大話，憑肉體的情慾，用邪蕩的事，引誘那些剛能逃脫在錯謬中生活者的人，

footnotes.zh: 或，为人，举止。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，為人，舉止。
footnotes.en: 2:18 1 live Or, behave, conduct themselves.

refs.text_gb: 知道你们得赎，脱离你们祖宗所传流虚妄的生活，不是用能坏的金银等物，
refs.text_big5: 知道你們得贖，脫離你們祖宗所傳流虛妄的生活，不是用能壞的金銀等物，
refs.text_en: Knowing that it was not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, that you were redeemed from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers,

refs.text_gb: 因为他们虽然知道神，却不当作神荣耀祂，也不感谢祂，反倒在他们的推想上变为虚妄，他们无知的心就昏暗了。
refs.text_big5: 因為他們雖然知道神，卻不當作神榮耀祂，也不感謝祂，反倒在他們的推想上變為虛妄，他們無知的心就昏暗了。
refs.text_en: Because though they knew God, they did not glorify Him as God or thank Him, but rather became vain in their reasonings, and their heart, lacking understanding, was darkened.

refs.text_gb: 亲爱的，我劝你们作客旅和寄居的，要禁戒属肉体的私欲，这私欲是与魂战斗的；
refs.text_big5: 親愛的，我勸你們作客旅和寄居的，要禁戒屬肉體的私慾，這私慾是與魂戰鬥的；
refs.text_en: Beloved, I entreat you as strangers and sojourners to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul,

refs.text_gb: 好使你们不再从人的情欲，只从神的旨意，在肉身中度余下的光阴。
refs.text_big5: 好使你們不再從人的情慾，只從神的旨意，在肉身中度餘下的光陰。
refs.text_en: No longer to live the rest of the time in the flesh in the lusts of men, but in the will of God.

refs.text_gb: 对那些放纵污秽的情欲，随从肉体，并轻慢主治者的人，更是如此。他们胆大任性，毁谤在尊位的也不战惊；
refs.text_big5: 對那些放縱污穢的情慾，隨從肉體，並輕慢主治者的人，更是如此。他們膽大任性，毀謗在尊位的也不戰驚；
refs.text_en: And especially those who go after the flesh in the lust for defilement and despise lordship. Daring, self-willed, they do not tremble while reviling dignities;

refs.text_gb: 满眼是淫色，止不住犯罪；引诱那不坚固的人，心中习惯了贪婪，是被咒诅的儿女；
refs.text_big5: 滿眼是淫色，止不住犯罪；引誘那不堅固的人，心中習慣了貪婪，是被咒詛的兒女；
refs.text_en: Having eyes full of adultery and not ceasing from sin; enticing unstable souls, having a heart exercised for covetousness, children of curse.

refs.text_gb: 倘若他们因认识主和救主耶稣基督，得以逃脱世上的污秽，却又在其中被缠住制伏，他们末后的景况，就比先前更不好了。
refs.text_big5: 倘若他們因認識主和救主耶穌基督，得以逃脫世上的污穢，卻又在其中被纏住制伏，他們末後的景況，就比先前更不好了。
refs.text_en: For if, having escaped the defilements of the world by the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ but having again been entangled in these, they are defeated, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

refs.text_gb: 借这荣耀和美德，祂已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫你们既逃离世上从情欲来的败坏，就借着这些应许，得有分于神的性情。
refs.text_big5: 藉這榮耀和美德，祂已將又寶貴又極大的應許賜給我們，叫你們既逃離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就藉著這些應許，得有分於神的性情。
refs.text_en: Through which He has granted to us precious and exceedingly great promises that through these you might become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption which is in the world by lust.

verses.text_gb: 应许他们自[Cra]由，自己却是败[Fn1]坏的奴[Crb]仆，因为人被谁制伏，就[Fn2]是谁的奴仆。
verses.text_big5: 應許他們自[Cra]由，自己卻是敗[Fn1]壞的奴[Crb]僕，因為人被誰制伏，就[Fn2]是誰的奴僕。
verses.text_en: Promising freedom to them, while they themselves are slaves of corruption; for by whom anyone has been defeated, by this one he has been enslaved.
verses.text_gb_plain: 应许他们自由，自己却是败坏的奴仆，因为人被谁制伏，就是谁的奴仆。
verses.text_big5_plain: 應許他們自由，自己卻是敗壞的奴僕，因為人被誰制伏，就是誰的奴僕。

footnotes.zh: 见1注5第三点。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見1註5第三點。
footnotes.en: 2:19 1 corruption See note 2 Pet. 2:1 5 , point 3.

footnotes.zh: 或，就对谁是奴仆。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，就對誰是奴僕。
footnotes.en: 2:19 2 by Or, to.

refs.text_gb: 你们是自由的，不可用自由遮盖恶毒，却要作神的奴仆。
refs.text_big5: 你們是自由的，不可用自由遮蓋惡毒，卻要作神的奴僕。
refs.text_en: As free, and yet not having freedom as a covering for evil, but as slaves of God.

refs.text_gb: 基督释放了我们，叫我们得以自由；所以要站立得住，不要再受奴役的轭挟制。
refs.text_big5: 基督釋放了我們，叫我們得以自由；所以要站立得住，不要再受奴役的軛挾制。
refs.text_en: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free; stand fast therefore, and do not be entangled with a yoke of slavery again.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，你们蒙召原是为得自由；只是不可将自由当作放纵肉体的机会，倒要凭着爱互相服事。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，你們蒙召原是為得自由；只是不可將自由當作放縱肉體的機會，倒要憑著愛互相服事。
refs.text_en: For you were called for freedom, brothers; only do not turn this freedom into an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.

refs.text_gb: 唯有详细察看那完备自由的律法，并且时常如此的，他不是听了就忘，乃是实在行出来，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
refs.text_big5: 惟有詳細察看那完備自由的律法，並且時常如此的，他不是聽了就忘，乃是實在行出來，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
refs.text_en: But he who looks into the perfect law, the law of freedom, and continues in it, becoming not a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work, this one will be blessed in his doing.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，我实实在在地告诉你们，凡犯罪的，就是罪的奴仆。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，我實實在在的告訴你們，凡犯罪的，就是罪的奴僕。
refs.text_en: Jesus answered them, Truly, truly, I say to you, Everyone who commits sin is a slave of sin.

refs.text_gb: 岂不晓得你们将自己献给谁作奴仆，以至于顺从，就作了你们所顺从者的奴仆么？或作罪的奴仆，以至于死，或作顺从的奴仆，以至于义。
refs.text_big5: 豈不曉得你們將自己獻給誰作奴僕，以至於順從，就作了你們所順從者的奴僕麼？或作罪的奴僕，以至於死，或作順從的奴僕，以至於義。
refs.text_en: Do you not know that to whom you present yourselves as slaves for obedience, his slaves you are whom you obey, whether of sin unto death or of obedience unto righteousness?

verses.text_gb: 倘若他们因认[Cra]识主和救主耶稣基督，得以逃[Crb]脱世[Crc]上的污[Crd]秽，却又在其中被缠[Cre]住制伏，他们末后的景况，就比先前更[Crf]不好了。
verses.text_big5: 倘若他們因認[Cra]識主和救主耶穌基督，得以逃[Crb]脫世[Crc]上的污[Crd]穢，卻又在其中被纏[Cre]住制伏，他們末後的景況，就比先前更[Crf]不好了。
verses.text_en: For if, having escaped the defilements of the world by the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ but having again been entangled in these, they are defeated, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
verses.text_gb_plain: 倘若他们因认识主和救主耶稣基督，得以逃脱世上的污秽，却又在其中被缠住制伏，他们末后的景况，就比先前更不好了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 倘若他們因認識主和救主耶穌基督，得以逃脫世上的污穢，卻又在其中被纏住制伏，他們末後的景況，就比先前更不好了。

refs.text_gb: 愿恩典与平安，因你们充分认识神和我们的主耶稣，繁增的归与你们。
refs.text_big5: 願恩典與平安，因你們充分認識神和我們的主耶穌，繁增的歸與你們。
refs.text_en: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the full knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;

refs.text_gb: 因为他们说虚妄矜夸的大话，凭肉体的情欲，用邪荡的事，引诱那些刚能逃脱在错谬中生活者的人，
refs.text_big5: 因為他們說虛妄矜誇的大話，憑肉體的情慾，用邪蕩的事，引誘那些剛能逃脫在錯謬中生活者的人，
refs.text_en: For uttering great swelling words of vanity, they entice by lusts of the flesh, with licentiousness, those who are barely escaping from them who live in error;

refs.text_gb: 借这荣耀和美德，祂已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫你们既逃离世上从情欲来的败坏，就借着这些应许，得有分于神的性情。
refs.text_big5: 藉這榮耀和美德，祂已將又寶貴又極大的應許賜給我們，叫你們既逃離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就藉著這些應許，得有分於神的性情。
refs.text_en: Through which He has granted to us precious and exceedingly great promises that through these you might become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption which is in the world by lust.

refs.text_gb: 不要爱世界，和世界上的事。人若爱世界，爱父的心就不在他里面了；
refs.text_big5: 不要愛世界，和世界上的事。人若愛世界，愛父的心就不在他裏面了；
refs.text_en: Do not love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in him;

refs.text_gb: 因为凡世界上的事，就是肉体的情欲、眼目的情欲、并今生的骄傲，都不是出于父，乃是出于世界。
refs.text_big5: 因為凡世界上的事，就是肉體的情慾、眼目的情慾、並今生的驕傲，都不是出於父，乃是出於世界。
refs.text_en: Because all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vainglory of life, is not of the Father but is of the world.

refs.text_gb: 这世界和其上的情欲，正在过去；唯独实行神旨意的，永远长存。
refs.text_big5: 這世界和其上的情慾，正在過去；惟獨實行神旨意的，永遠長存。
refs.text_en: And the world is passing away, and its lust, but he who does the will of God abides forever.

refs.text_gb: 我们晓得我们是属神的，而整个世界都卧在那恶者里面。
refs.text_big5: 我們曉得我們是屬神的，而整個世界都臥在那惡者裏面。
refs.text_en: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the evil one.

refs.text_gb: 你们这些淫乱的人，岂不知与世界为友，就是与神为敌么？所以凡想要与世界为友的，就成了神的仇敌。
refs.text_big5: 你們這些淫亂的人，豈不知與世界為友，就是與神為敵麼？所以凡想要與世界為友的，就成了神的仇敵。
refs.text_en: Adulteresses, do you not know that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? Therefore whoever determines to be a friend of the world is constituted an enemy of God.

refs.text_gb: 对那些放纵污秽的情欲，随从肉体，并轻慢主治者的人，更是如此。他们胆大任性，毁谤在尊位的也不战惊；
refs.text_big5: 對那些放縱污穢的情慾，隨從肉體，並輕慢主治者的人，更是如此。他們膽大任性，毀謗在尊位的也不戰驚；
refs.text_en: And especially those who go after the flesh in the lust for defilement and despise lordship. Daring, self-willed, they do not tremble while reviling dignities;

refs.text_gb: 凡当兵的，不让今生的事务缠身，好叫那招他入伍的人喜悦。
refs.text_big5: 凡當兵的，不讓今生的事務纏身，好叫那招他入伍的人喜悅。
refs.text_en: No one serving as a soldier entangles himself with the affairs of this life, that he may please the one who enlisted him.

refs.text_gb: 所以，我们既有这许多的见证人，如同云彩围着我们，就当脱去各样的重担，和容易缠累我们的罪，凭着忍耐奔那摆在我们前头的赛程，
refs.text_big5: 所以，我們既有這許多的見證人，如同雲彩圍著我們，就當脫去各樣的重擔，和容易纏累我們的罪，憑著忍耐奔那擺在我們前頭的賽程，
refs.text_en: Therefore let us also, having so great a cloud of witnesses surrounding us, put away every encumbrance and the sin which so easily entangles us and run with endurance the race which is set before us,

refs.text_gb: 于是去另带了七个比自己更恶的灵来，一同进去，住在那里。那人末后的景况，就比先前更坏了。这邪恶的世代，也要如此。
refs.text_big5: 於是去另帶了七個比自己更惡的靈來，一同進去，住在那裏。那人末後的景況，就比先前更壞了。這邪惡的世代，也要如此。
refs.text_en: Then it goes and takes along with itself seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter in and settle down there. And the last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Thus shall it be also with this evil generation.

verses.text_gb: 他们认识义[Fn1]路，竟转[Cra]离所传授给他们神[Crb]圣的诫命，倒不如不认识为妙。
verses.text_big5: 他們認識義[Fn1]路，竟轉[Cra]離所傳授給他們神[Crb]聖的誡命，倒不如不認識為妙。
verses.text_en: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们认识义路，竟转离所传授给他们神圣的诫命，倒不如不认识为妙。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們認識義路，竟轉離所傳授給他們神聖的誡命，倒不如不認識為妙。

footnotes.zh: 义路就是过着与神与人都是对的生活，是真理的路(2与注2)和正路(15与注1)的另一面。这是照着神公义而活的路；能为着神公义的国(罗十四17，太五20)，接受神行政审判(3，9)的路。彼得在他的书信里强调生活的方式(品行、行事为人)和生活的路，因为他所写的是基于神行政管理的观点。神的子民要符合这位圣别、公义之神的行政，就需要在祂公义和真理的正路上，过圣别、纯洁、美好、佳美的生活(彼前一15，三16，2，二12，彼后三11)，而非邪荡、虚妄的生活(7，彼前一18)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 義路就是過著與神與人都是對的生活，是真理的路（2與註2）和正路（15與註1）的另一面。這是照著神公義而活的路；能為著神公義的國，（羅十四17，太五20，）接受神行政審判（3，9）的路。彼得在他的書信裏強調生活的方式（品行、行事為人）和生活的路，因為他所寫的是基於神行政管理的觀點。神的子民要符合這位聖別、公義之神的行政，就需要在祂公義和真理的正路上，過聖別、純潔、美好、佳美的生活，（彼前一15，三16，2，二12，彼後三11，）而非邪蕩、虛妄的生活。（7，彼前一18。）
footnotes.en: 2:21 1 way To take the way of righteousness is to live a life that is right with both God and man; it is another aspect of the way of the truth (v. 2 and note 2 Pet. 2:2 2 ) and the straight way (v. 15 and note 2 Pet. 2:15 1 ). This is the way of living a life according to God's righteousness, a way that can receive His governmental judgment (vv. 3, 9) for His kingdom of righteousness (Rom. 14:17; Matt. 5:20). Peter in his Epistles stressed both the manner of life and the way of life because his writings are based on the governmental point of view of God's administration. To correspond with the government of Him who is holy and righteous, God's people need to have a manner of life that is holy, pure, good, and excellent (1 Pet. 1:15; 2, 3:16; 2:12; 2 Pet. 3:11), not licentious and vain (v. 7; 1 Pet. 1:18), in His straight way of righteousness and truth.

refs.text_gb: 义人若转离他的义作了罪孽，照着恶人所行一切可憎的事而行，他岂能存活么？他所行一切的义都不被记念；他必因所行不忠的事，并因所犯的罪死亡。
refs.text_big5: 義人若轉離他的義作了罪孽，照著惡人所行一切可憎的事而行，他豈能存活麼？他所行一切的義都不被記念；他必因所行不忠的事，並因所犯的罪死亡。
refs.text_en: But when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity and commits all the abominations that the wicked man commits, will he live? None of his righteousness that he has practiced shall be remembered. Because of his unfaithfulness in which he has acted unfaithfully and because of his sin which he has sinned, because of them, he shall die.

refs.text_gb: 这样看来，律法是圣的，诫命也是圣的、义的并善的。
refs.text_big5: 這樣看來，律法是聖的，誡命也是聖的、義的並善的。
refs.text_en: So then the law is holy, and the commandment holy and righteous and good.

verses.text_gb: 俗语说得真对，狗[Fn1][Cra]所吐的，它转过来又吃；猪洗净了，又到泥里去滚。这话在他们身上发生了。
verses.text_big5: 俗語說得真對，狗[Fn1][Cra]所吐的，牠轉過來又喫；豬洗淨了，又到泥裏去滾。這話在他們身上發生了。
verses.text_en: It has happened to them according to the true proverb: The dog has turned to its own vomit, and the washed sow to wallowing in the mud.
verses.text_gb_plain: 俗语说得真对，狗所吐的，它转过来又吃；猪洗净了，又到泥里去滚。这话在他们身上发生了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 俗語說得真對，狗所吐的，牠轉過來又喫；豬洗淨了，又到泥裏去滾。這話在他們身上發生了。

footnotes.zh: 照着神圣别的条例，狗和猪是不洁净的畜类(利十一27，7，太七6与注2)。狗惯于吃污秽的东西。它们吐出所吃的，转过来又吃进去，就把里面污秽了。猪在泥里打滚，就把自己外面污秽了。否认神的异端者，至终就像这些肮脏的畜类，把自己里外都污秽了。(在神管理的行政里，照着神的义，他们该受何等严厉地审判！)因此，他们最具传染力。信徒不得与他们接触(约贰9～11)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 照著神聖別的條例，狗和豬是不潔淨的畜類。（利十一27，7，太七6與註2。）狗慣於喫污穢的東西。牠們吐出所喫的，轉過來又喫進去，就把裏面污穢了。豬在泥裏打滾，就把自己外面污穢了。否認神的異端者，至終就像這些骯髒的畜類，把自己裏外都污穢了。（在神管理的行政裏，照著神的義，他們該受何等嚴厲的審判！）因此，他們最具傳染力。信徒不得與他們接觸。（約貳9～11。）
footnotes.en: 2:22 1 dog Dogs and sows are unclean animals according to the ordinances of God's holiness (7, Lev. 11:27; Matt. 7:6 and note Matt. 7:6 2 ). Dogs are accustomed to eating filthy things. They vomit what they eat and turn to their own vomit, becoming filthy inwardly. Sows wallow in the mud, making themselves filthy outwardly. The God-denying heretics eventually become like these dirty animals, making themselves filthy both inwardly and outwardly. (What serious judgment they deserve according to God's righteousness in His governmental administration!) Hence, they are very contagious, and the believers are prohibited from having contact with them (2 John 1:9-11).

refs.text_gb: 愚昧人重复愚妄事，就像狗转过来吃自己所吐的。
refs.text_big5: 愚昧人重複愚妄事，就像狗轉過來喫自己所吐的。
refs.text_en: Like a dog that returns to its vomit / Is a fool who repeats his folly.

verses.text_gb: 亲爱的，我现在写给你们的是第二封信；在这两封信中，我都是以提[Cra]醒激[Crb]发你们纯诚的心思，
verses.text_big5: 親愛的，我現在寫給你們的是第二封信；在這兩封信中，我都是以題[Cra]醒激[Crb]發你們純誠的心思，
verses.text_en: This second letter, beloved, I now write to you; in them both I stir up your sincere mind with a reminder,
verses.text_gb_plain: 亲爱的，我现在写给你们的是第二封信；在这两封信中，我都是以提醒激发你们纯诚的心思，
verses.text_big5_plain: 親愛的，我現在寫給你們的是第二封信；在這兩封信中，我都是以題醒激發你們純誠的心思，

refs.text_gb: 所以，你们虽已知道这些事，且在现有的真理上得了坚固，我还要常常提醒你们；
refs.text_big5: 所以，你們雖已知道這些事，且在現有的真理上得了堅固，我還要常常題醒你們；
refs.text_en: Therefore I will be ready always to remind you concerning these things, even though you know them and have been established in the present truth.

refs.text_gb: 但在有些点上，我更加放胆的写给你们，是要提醒你们，特因神所赐我的恩典，
refs.text_big5: 但在有些點上，我更加放膽的寫給你們，是要題醒你們，特因神所賜我的恩典，
refs.text_en: But I have written the more boldly to you on some points so as to remind you of them again because of the grace given to me by God

refs.text_gb: 我认为趁我还在这帐幕的时候，以提醒激发你们，是正当的，
refs.text_big5: 我認為趁我還在這帳幕的時候，以題醒激發你們，是正當的，
refs.text_en: And I consider it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by a reminder,

verses.text_gb: 叫你们记[Cra]念那借着圣申[Crb]言者预先所说的话[Fn1][Crc]，和你们的使[Crd]徒所传主和救主的命令。
verses.text_big5: 叫你們記[Cra]念那藉著聖申[Crb]言者豫先所說的話[Fn1][Crc]，和你們的使[Crd]徒所傳主和救主的命令。
verses.text_en: So that you would remember the words spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior preached by your apostles;
verses.text_gb_plain: 叫你们记念那借着圣申言者预先所说的话，和你们的使徒所传主和救主的命令。
verses.text_big5_plain: 叫你們記念那藉著聖申言者豫先所說的話，和你們的使徒所傳主和救主的命令。

footnotes.zh: 申言者所说的话乃是旧约(经书)的内容(16，一20)，使徒所传的命令乃是新约(使徒教训)的内容(徒二42)。彼得用这二者证实并加强他所写的，以预防背道中异端的教训。他在第一封书信里说到神完全的救恩，已经提到申言者和使徒(彼前一9～12)。然后在第二封书信里说到神圣真理的照亮，再次提到这两班人(一12～21)。这里是第三次提起。
footnotes.en: 3:2 1 words The words spoken by the prophets are the contents of the Old Testament, the Scriptures (v. 16; 1:20), and the commandments preached by the apostles are the contents of the New Testament, the apostles' teaching (Acts 2:42). Peter used both to confirm and strengthen his writings as an inoculation against the heretical teachings in the apostasy. In his first Epistle, concerning the full salvation of God, he referred to both the prophets and the apostles (1 Pet. 1:9-12). Then in the second Epistle, concerning the shining of the divine truth, he again referred to both (2 Pet. 1:12-21). Here, for the third time, he did the same.

refs.text_gb: 不仅如此，我也要竭力，使你们在我去世以后，时常记念这些事。
refs.text_big5: 不僅如此，我也要竭力，使你們在我去世以後，時常記念這些事。
refs.text_en: Moreover I will also be diligent that you may be able, after my exodus, to bring these things to mind at all times.

refs.text_big5: 神既在古時，藉著眾申言者，多分多方向列祖說話，
refs.text_en: God, having spoken of old in many portions and in many ways to the fathers in the prophets,

refs.text_gb: 关于这救恩，那预言你们要得恩典的众申言者，已经详细地寻求考察过，
refs.text_big5: 關於這救恩，那豫言你們要得恩典的眾申言者，已經詳細的尋求考察過，

refs.text_gb: 我们并有申言者更确定的话，你们留意这话，如同留意照在暗处的灯，直等到天发亮，晨星在你们心里出现，你们就作得好了；
refs.text_big5: 我們並有申言者更確定的話，你們留意這話，如同留意照在暗處的燈，直等到天發亮，晨星在你們心裏出現，你們就作得好了；
refs.text_en: And we have the prophetic word made more firm, to which you do well to give heed as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts;

refs.text_gb: 第一要知道，经上所有的预言，都不是人自己的见解；
refs.text_big5: 第一要知道，經上所有的豫言，都不是人自己的見解；

refs.text_big5: 因為豫言從來沒有發自人的意思，乃是人被聖靈推動，從神說出來的。
refs.text_en: For no prophecy was ever borne by the will of man, but men spoke from God while being borne by the Holy Spirit.

refs.text_gb: 他们故意不理这件事，就是从太古凭神的话有了诸天，和出于水并借着水存立的地。
refs.text_big5: 他們故意不理這件事，就是從太古憑神的話有了諸天，和出於水並藉著水存立的地。
refs.text_en: For this escapes them by their own choosing, that by the word of God the heavens were of old and the earth was compacted out of water and through water,

refs.text_gb: 但现在的诸天和地，还是凭着同样的话保留着，直留到不敬虔的人受审判遭毁坏的日子，给火焚烧。
refs.text_big5: 但現在的諸天和地，還是憑著同樣的話保留著，直留到不敬虔的人受審判遭毀壞的日子，給火焚燒。
refs.text_en: But the heavens and the earth now, by the same word, have been stored up for fire, being kept unto the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

refs.text_en: No longer to live the rest of the time in the flesh in the lusts of men, but in the will of God.

refs.text_gb: 借这荣耀和美德，祂已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫你们既逃离世上从情欲来的败坏，就借着这些应许，得有分于神的性情。
refs.text_big5: 藉這榮耀和美德，祂已將又寶貴又極大的應許賜給我們，叫你們既逃離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就藉著這些應許，得有分於神的性情。
refs.text_en: Through which He has granted to us precious and exceedingly great promises that through these you might become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption which is in the world by lust.

refs.text_gb: 但各人被试诱，乃是被自己的私欲勾引诱惑的；
refs.text_big5: 但各人被試誘，乃是被自己的私慾勾引誘惑的；
refs.text_en: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away and enticed by his own lusts;

refs.text_gb: 然后私欲怀了胎，就生出罪；罪既长成，就产生死。
refs.text_big5: 然後私慾懷了胎，就生出罪；罪既長成，就產生死。
refs.text_en: Then the lust, having conceived, gives birth to sin; and the sin, when it is fully grown, brings forth death.

refs.text_gb: 你们中间的争战是从哪里来的？斗殴是从哪里来的？岂不是从你们肢体中交战的私欲来的么？
refs.text_big5: 你們中間的爭戰是從那裏來的？鬥毆是從那裏來的？豈不是從你們肢體中交戰的私慾來的麼？
refs.text_en: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Are they not from this, from your pleasures that war in your members?

verses.text_gb: 主[Cra]来[Fn1][Crb]临的应[Fn2][Crc]许在哪里？因为从列[Crd]祖睡[Cre]了以来，万物依然存在，如同从创[Crf]造之初[Crg]一样。
verses.text_big5: 主[Cra]來[Fn1][Crb]臨的應[Fn2][Crc]許在那裏？因為從列[Crd]祖睡[Cre]了以來，萬物依然存在，如同從創[Crf]造之初[Crg]一樣。
verses.text_en: And saying, Where is the promise of His coming? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue in this way from the beginning of creation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 主来临的应许在哪里？因为从列祖睡了以来，万物依然存在，如同从创造之初一样。
verses.text_big5_plain: 主來臨的應許在那裏？因為從列祖睡了以來，萬物依然存在，如同從創造之初一樣。

refs.text_gb: 他们对我说，耶和华的话在哪里呢？叫这话应验吧。
refs.text_big5: 他們對我說，耶和華的話在那裏呢？叫這話應驗罷。
refs.text_en: Indeed, they say to me, / Where is the word of Jehovah? / Let it come now!

refs.text_gb: 我们曾将我们主耶稣基督的大能，和祂的来临告诉你们，并不是随从乖巧捏造的虚构无稽之事，乃是作祂威荣的亲眼见证人。
refs.text_big5: 我們曾將我們主耶穌基督的大能，和祂的來臨告訴你們，並不是隨從乖巧捏造的虛構無稽之事，乃是作祂威榮的親眼見證人。
refs.text_en: For we did not follow cleverly devised myths when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we became eyewitnesses of that One's majesty.

refs.text_gb: 主所应许的，祂并不耽延，像有些人以为祂耽延一样；其实祂乃是宽容你们，不愿任何人遭毁坏，乃愿人人都趋前悔改。
refs.text_big5: 主所應許的，祂並不耽延，像有些人以為祂耽延一樣；其實祂乃是寬容你們，不願任何人遭毀壞，乃願人人都趨前悔改。
refs.text_en: The Lord does not delay regarding the promise, as some count delay, but is long-suffering toward you, not intending that any perish but that all advance to repentance.

refs.text_gb: 但我们照祂的应许，期待新天新地，有义居住在其中。
refs.text_big5: 但我們照祂的應許，期待新天新地，有義居住在其中。
refs.text_en: But according to His promise we are expecting new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

refs.text_gb: 借这荣耀和美德，祂已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫你们既逃离世上从情欲来的败坏，就借着这些应许，得有分于神的性情。
refs.text_big5: 藉這榮耀和美德，祂已將又寶貴又極大的應許賜給我們，叫你們既逃離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就藉著這些應許，得有分於神的性情。
refs.text_en: Through which He has granted to us precious and exceedingly great promises that through these you might become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption which is in the world by lust.

refs.text_en: Whose are the fathers, and out of whom, as regards what is according to flesh, is the Christ, who is over all, God blessed forever. Amen.

refs.text_big5: 又跪下，大聲喊著說，主阿，不要將這罪歸與他們！說了這話，就睡了。掃羅也贊同他被殺。
refs.text_en: And kneeling down, he cried out with a loud voice, Lord, do not hold this sin against them. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

verses.text_gb: 他[Fn1]们故意不理这件事，就是从太古凭神[Fn2]的话[Cra]有[Crb]了诸[Fn3][Crc]天，和出于水并借着水[Crd]存[Fn4]立的地。

footnotes.zh: 直译，因着他们自愿，这件事就向他们隐藏了。即他们故意不理这件事，所以这件事就避开了他们的注意。异端的讥诮者故意不理且有意否认，神借着申言者在经书上所说的话。因此彼得提醒信徒，要记念旧约申言者和新约使徒所说的圣言(1～2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，因著他們自願，這件事就向他們隱藏了。即他們故意不理這件事，所以這件事就避開了他們的注意。異端的譏誚者故意不理且有意否認，神藉著申言者在經書上所說的話。因此彼得題醒信徒，要記念舊約申言者和新約使徒所說的聖言。（1～2。）
footnotes.en: 3:5 1 this Or, this is hidden from them by their own willfulness. I.e., they are willfully ignorant of this; hence, this escapes their notice. The heretical mockers ignore willfully and deny purposely the word of God spoken by the prophets in the Scriptures. So Peter reminded the believers to remember the holy words spoken by both the Old Testament prophets and the New Testament apostles (vv. 1-2).

footnotes.zh: 主来临的应许(4)乃是神的话。诸天和地是凭神的话而成的(来十一3)，也是凭同样的话得以保留(来一3)，直留到不敬虔的人受审判遭毁坏的日子(7)。好讥诮的人不该不理这事，他们应当确信，凭着神的话，整个物质的宇宙，包括他们自己在内，都要因主来临受审判。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主來臨的應許（4）乃是神的話。諸天和地是憑神的話而成的，（來十一3，）也是憑同樣的話得以保留，（來一3，）直留到不敬虔的人受審判遭毀壞的日子。（7。）好譏誚的人不該不理這事，他們應當確信，憑著神的話，整個物質的宇宙，包括他們自己在內，都要因主來臨受審判。
footnotes.en: 3:5 2 word The promise concerning the Lord's coming (v. 4) is the word of God. The mockers should not ignore that it was by the word of God that the heavens and the earth came into existence (Heb. 11:3) and that it is by the same word that the heavens and the earth are being kept (Heb. 1:3) for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men (v. 7). So the mockers should be assured that by the word of God all the material universe, which includes them, will be judged by the coming of the Lord.

footnotes.zh: 起初，就是太古，神创造了诸天和地(创一1)。凭着神的话，先有了诸天(诗三三6)，然后有了地(伯三八4～7)。
footnotes.en: 3:5 3 earth In the beginning, that is, of old, the heavens and the earth were created by God (Gen. 1:1). By the word of God (Psa. 33:6) first the heavens came into existence and then the earth (Job 38:4-7).

footnotes.zh: 存立，直译，同立，并立(并列，并排)。在创一1先有了地，然后在创一9，地又借着神的话(说话——诗三三9)，开始出于水并借着水而存立，就是与水并立，一部分露出水面，一部分沉在水中。
footnotes.zh_big5: 存立，直譯，同立，並立（並列，並排）。在創一1先有了地，然後在創一9，地又藉著神的話（說話─詩三三9），開始出於水並藉著水而存立，就是與水並立，一部分露出水面，一部分沉在水中。
footnotes.en: 3:5 4 compacted Lit., standing together, standing with (in juxtaposition, side by side). First, in Gen. 1:1 the earth came into existence, and then, in Gen. 1:9, also by the word (the speaking) of God (Psa. 33:9), the earth began to be compacted out of water and through water, that is, to stand together with water in juxtaposition, emerging partly from the water and remaining partly submerged under water.

refs.text_en: So that you would remember the words spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior preached by your apostles;

refs.text_big5: 但現在的諸天和地，還是憑著同樣的話保留著，直留到不敬虔的人受審判遭毀壞的日子，給火焚燒。
refs.text_en: But the heavens and the earth now, by the same word, have been stored up for fire, being kept unto the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

refs.text_big5: 萬物是藉著祂成的；凡已成的，沒有一樣不是藉著祂成的。
refs.text_en: All things came into being through Him, and apart from Him not one thing came into being which has come into being.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华论以色列之话语的默示。铺张诸天、建立地基、造人里面之灵的耶和华说，
refs.text_big5: 耶和華論以色列之話語的默示。鋪張諸天、建立地基、造人裏面之靈的耶和華說，
refs.text_en: The burden of the word of Jehovah concerning Israel. Thus declares Jehovah, who stretches forth the heavens and lays the foundations of the earth and forms the spirit of man within him,

refs.text_big5: 祂把地奠定在海上，堅立在江河之上。
refs.text_en: For it is He who founded it upon the seas / And established it upon the streams.

refs.text_gb: 要称谢那铺地在水以上的，因祂的慈爱永远长存；
refs.text_big5: 要稱謝那鋪地在水以上的，因祂的慈愛永遠長存；
refs.text_en: To Him who spread forth the earth over the waters, / For His lovingkindness is forever;

verses.text_gb: 借着这[Fn1]些水，当[Fn2]时的世[Fn3][Cra]界被水[Fn4]淹[Crb]没，就毁[Fn5][Crc]灭了；
verses.text_big5: 藉著這[Fn1]些水，當[Fn2]時的世[Fn3][Cra]界被水[Fn4]淹[Crb]沒，就毀[Fn5][Crc]滅了；
verses.text_en: Through which the world then, being flooded with water, perished.
verses.text_gb_plain: 借着这些水，当时的世界被水淹没，就毁灭了；
verses.text_big5_plain: 藉著這些水，當時的世界被水淹沒，就毀滅了；

footnotes.zh: 指5节的水。地有秩序的从水而出，并借水存立。但在挪亚的时候，地却借着同样的水受了审判，被洪水毁灭(创七17～24)，指明万物与创造之初并不一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指5節的水。地有秩序的從水而出，並藉水存立。但在挪亞的時候，地卻藉著同樣的水受了審判，被洪水毀滅，（創七17～24，）指明萬物與創造之初並不一樣。
footnotes.en: 3:6 1 which Referring to water in v. 5. The earth was compacted out of water and through water in an orderly condition. But through the same water it was judged and destroyed by the flood at Noah's time (Gen. 7:17-24), indicating that all things did not continue in the same way from the beginning of creation.

footnotes.zh: 指挪亚的世代。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指挪亞的世代。
footnotes.en: 3:6 2 world The Greek word means order, a system, referring here to the world with its inhabitants. The earth in the preceding verse became the world in this verse — not merely the earth, but the earth with its inhabitants in a system. This refers to the world in Noah's age, which was judged by God with the flood because of the sinfulness and ungodliness of that age (Gen. 6:5-7, 11-13, 17). This book is concerned mainly with the divine government and all its judgments. The first judgment on the world was the one executed by the flood in Noah's day, which cleared up that ungodly world. This must have been Peter's thought while he was writing this verse, implying that this age of apostasy will also be judged on the day of the Lord's appearing, as in the day of Noah (Matt. 24:37-39).

footnotes.zh: 原文意秩序、体系，指世界连同其上的居民。前节的地成了本节的世界；不仅是地，乃是有体系的地，连同其上的居民。这是指挪亚世代的世界，由于那世代的罪恶与不敬虔，就被神用洪水审判了(创六5～7，11～13，17)。本书主要的是说到神圣的行政及其一切的审判。头一次对世界的审判，乃是在挪亚的日子用洪水所施行的，把那不敬虔的世界清理了。彼得写本节的时候，他里面必有这思想，含示这背道的世代也要在主显现的日子受审判，就如在挪亚的日子一样(太二四37～39)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文意秩序、體系，指世界連同其上的居民。前節的地成了本節的世界；不僅是地，乃是有體系的地，連同其上的居民。這是指挪亞世代的世界，由於那世代的罪惡與不敬虔，就被神用洪水審判了。（創六5～7，11～13，17。）本書主要的是說到神聖的行政及其一切的審判。頭一次對世界的審判，乃是在挪亞的日子用洪水所施行的，把那不敬虔的世界清理了。彼得寫本節的時候，他裏面必有這思想，含示這背道的世代也要在主顯現的日子受審判，就如在挪亞的日子一樣。（太二四37～39。）
footnotes.en: 3:6 3 then Then refers to the age of Noah.

footnotes.zh: 指挪亚的时候使地毁灭(创六13，17，九11)的洪水(二5)。当时的地不再和以前一样，乃因洪水泛滥有了剧变，而被毁灭。这里是彼得对异端讥诮者有力的争辩。他们说，万物依然存在，如同从创造之初一样。但事实上，地因着其上居民的不敬虔，曾经发生过剧变。这含示现今的世界不会照现在的样子存留，却要因着主的来临，以及祂对背叛之人(包括背道的假教师，和异端的讥诮者)的审判，再有一次剧变。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指挪亞的時候使地毀滅（創六13，17，九11）的洪水。（二5。）當時的地不再和以前一樣，乃因洪水氾濫有了劇變，而被毀滅。這裏是彼得對異端譏誚者有力的爭辯。他們說，萬物依然存在，如同從創造之初一樣。但事實上，地因著其上居民的不敬虔，曾經發生過劇變。這含示現今的世界不會照現在的樣子存留，卻要因著主的來臨，以及祂對背叛之人（包括背道的假教師，和異端的譏誚者）的審判，再有一次劇變。
footnotes.en: 3:6 4 flooded Referring to the flood of Noah's time (2 Pet. 2:5), which caused the earth to be destroyed (Gen. 6:13, 17; 9:11). The earth then did not remain the same but experienced a cataclysm by being flooded with water, and was destroyed. Here Peter argued strongly with the heretical mockers. They said that "all things continue in this way from the beginning of creation" (v. 4). But actually a cataclysm did come upon the earth because of the ungodliness of its inhabitants. This implies that the present world will not continue in the same way but will experience another cataclysm through the Lord's coming with His judgment upon the rebellious, including the false teachers and the heretical mockers in the apostasy.

footnotes.zh: 即遭毁坏，被拆毁，被损毁(创六13，17)。见二1注5第一点。

footnotes.zh: 同样的话，指5节神的话，就是包括在旧约里申言者之话中的。在背道中虚假、异端的教训，乃是偏离了神在旧约里借众申言者所说的话，以及神在新约里借众使徒所说的话。因此，彼得预防背道教训的毒素所用的抗毒剂，就是他所一再强调，那带有神圣启示的圣言。
footnotes.zh_big5: 同樣的話，指5節神的話，就是包括在舊約裏申言者之話中的。在背道中虛假、異端的教訓，乃是偏離了神在舊約裏藉眾申言者所說的話，以及神在新約裏藉眾使徒所說的話。因此，彼得豫防背道教訓的毒素所用的抗毒劑，就是他所一再強調，那帶有神聖啟示的聖言。
footnotes.en: 3:7 2 same The same word refers to the word of God mentioned in v. 5, which is included in the words of the prophets in the Old Testament. The false and heretical teachings in the apostasy are a deviation from the word of God spoken by the prophets in the Old Testament and the apostles in the New Testament. Hence, the antidote administered through Peter's inoculation against the poison of the apostate teachings was the holy word with the divine revelation, which Peter stressed repeatedly.

footnotes.zh: 即储存着。

footnotes.en: 3:7 3 fire The fire that will burn up the heavens and the earth (v. 10) at the end of the millennium when the judgment of the great white throne comes (Rev. 20:11). God's initial judgment upon the universe was by water (v. 6), but His consummate judgment will be by fire. Water only washes away the filthiness from the surface, but fire changes the nature of the entire substance. This is another indication that the heavens and the earth will not remain the same as they are but will be cleared up by fire, and that the ungodly false teachers (2 Pet. 2:1) and mockers (v. 3) will be judged and destroyed under the divine government.

footnotes.en: 3:7 4 judgment The judgment of the great white throne, which will take place after the millennium and will precede the new heaven and new earth (Rev. 20:11-15; 21:1). Through that judgment all the ungodly will be cast into the lake of fire for destruction (see note 2 Pet. 2:3 1 ). Since it will be the final judgment upon men and the demons (Rev. 20:13 and note Rev. 20:13 1 ), it is of the greatest relevance to the government of God in the universe. See note 1 Pet. 1:17 2 , par. 2. Here Peter skipped over the millennium of one thousand years, going directly from the Lord's coming to the judgment of the great white throne. To him, as to the Lord, that one thousand years will be like one day (v. 8), a short time. He was dealing here with God's governmental judgment. In God's economy the millennium is not for that purpose.

footnotes.zh: 对于永远的主神，时间的感觉比人的少千万倍。因此，为了应验祂的话，特别是祂应许的话，要紧的不是时间，乃是事实。无论祂应许了什么，迟早总要成为事实。我们不该照着我们对时间的算法，感觉耽延而作难。
footnotes.zh_big5: 對於永遠的主神，時間的感覺比人的少千萬倍。因此，為了應驗祂的話，特別是祂應許的話，要緊的不是時間，乃是事實。無論祂應許了甚麼，遲早總要成為事實。我們不該照著我們對時間的算法，感覺耽延而作難。
footnotes.en: 3:8 2 one With the Lord God, who is eternal, the sense of time is compressed a thousandfold compared with man's sense of time. Hence, for the fulfillment of His word, especially the word of His promise, the crucial matter is not the time but the fact. Whatever He has promised will sooner or later become a fact. We should not be troubled by the sense of delay according to our reckoning of time.

refs.text_en: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection; over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years.

verses.text_gb: 主所应[Cra]许的，祂并不耽[Fn1][Crb]延，像有[Fn2]些人以为祂耽[Crc]延一样；其实祂乃是宽[Fn3][Crd]容你们，不愿任何人遭[Fn4]毁[Cre]坏，乃愿人[Fn5][Crf]人都趋前悔[Fn6][Crg]改。
verses.text_big5: 主所應[Cra]許的，祂並不耽[Fn1][Crb]延，像有[Fn2]些人以為祂耽[Crc]延一樣；其實祂乃是寬[Fn3][Crd]容你們，不願任何人遭[Fn4]毀[Cre]壞，乃願人[Fn5][Crf]人都趨前悔[Fn6][Crg]改。
verses.text_en: The Lord does not delay regarding the promise, as some count delay, but is long-suffering toward you, not intending that any perish but that all advance to repentance.
verses.text_gb_plain: 主所应许的，祂并不耽延，像有些人以为祂耽延一样；其实祂乃是宽容你们，不愿任何人遭毁坏，乃愿人人都趋前悔改。
verses.text_big5_plain: 主所應許的，祂並不耽延，像有些人以為祂耽延一樣；其實祂乃是寬容你們，不願任何人遭毀壞，乃願人人都趨前悔改。

footnotes.zh: 或，迟缓。
footnotes.en: 3:9 1 does Or, is not tardy.

footnotes.zh: 必是指那些好讥诮的人(3)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 必是指那些好譏誚的人。（3。）
footnotes.en: 3:9 2 some These must be the mockers (v. 3).

footnotes.zh: 主的心不在意祂的应许得应验的时间，乃在意祂所特有作为珍宝的子民(彼前二9，多二14与注4)，叫我们这些祂所宝贵的赎民，没有一人因祂行政的审判受刑罚，反倒有一段延长的时间让我们悔改，使我们免受祂的刑罚。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主的心不在意祂的應許得應驗的時間，乃在意祂所特有作為珍寶的子民，（彼前二9，多二14與註4，）叫我們這些祂所寶貴的贖民，沒有一人因祂行政的審判受刑罰，反倒有一段延長的時間讓我們悔改，使我們免受祂的刑罰。
footnotes.en: 3:9 3 delay Or, tardiness.

footnotes.zh: 见二1注5第一点。既然本节的“你们”是指在基督里的信徒，“毁坏”就不是指不信之人永远的沉沦，乃是指神对信徒行政管教的刑罚(彼前四17～18，18注2，帖前五3，8与注2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見二1註5第一點。既然本節的“你們”是指在基督裏的信徒，“毀壞”就不是指不信之人永遠的沉淪，乃是指神對信徒行政管教的刑罰。（彼前四17～18，18註2，帖前五3，8與註2。）
footnotes.en: 3:9 4 long The Lord's heart is set not on the time of the fulfillment of His promise but on His people, whom He possesses peculiarly as a treasure (1 Pet. 2:9; Titus 2:14 and note Titus 2:14 3 ). His desire is that none of us, His precious redeemed ones, would be punished by His governmental judgment but would have a prolonged season to repent that we may be spared from His punishment.

footnotes.zh: 指信徒。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指信徒。
footnotes.en: 3:9 5 perish Or, be destroyed. See note 2 Pet. 2:1 5 , point 1. Since you in this verse refers to the believers in Christ, perish refers not to the eternal perdition of the unbelievers but to the punishment of God's governmental disciplining of the believers (1 Pet. 4:17-18 and note 1 Pet. 4:18 2 ; 1 Thes. 5:3, 8 and note 1 Thes. 5:8 3 ).

footnotes.zh: 即悔改以致得救(15)，指因着没有为主来的日子(10)儆醒，以及没有过圣别的生活和敬虔(11)而悔改。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即悔改以致得救，（15，）指因著沒有為主來的日子（10）儆醒，以及沒有過聖別的生活和敬虔（11）而悔改。
footnotes.en: 3:9 6 all Referring to the believers.

refs.text_gb: 主来临的应许在哪里？因为从列祖睡了以来，万物依然存在，如同从创造之初一样。
refs.text_big5: 主來臨的應許在那裏？因為從列祖睡了以來，萬物依然存在，如同從創造之初一樣。
refs.text_en: And saying, Where is the promise of His coming? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue in this way from the beginning of creation.

refs.text_gb: 但我们照祂的应许，期待新天新地，有义居住在其中。
refs.text_big5: 但我們照祂的應許，期待新天新地，有義居住在其中。
refs.text_en: But according to His promise we are expecting new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

refs.text_gb: 因为这异象有一定的时期，快要达到终局，并非虚谎；虽然迟延，还要等候；因为必然临到，不再耽延。
refs.text_big5: 因為這異象有一定的時期，快要達到終局，並非虛謊；雖然遲延，還要等候；因為必然臨到，不再耽延。
refs.text_en: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, / And it hastens toward the end and will not lie. / Though it tarries, wait for it; / For it will surely come; it will not delay.

refs.text_gb: “因为还有一点点时候，那要来的就来，并不迟延。
refs.text_big5: “因為還有一點點時候，那要來的就來，並不遲延。
refs.text_en: "For in yet a very little while the Coming One will come and will not delay.

refs.text_gb: 人子啊，关于以色列地，你们怎么有这俗语，说，日子迟延，一切异象都落空呢？
refs.text_big5: 人子阿，關於以色列地，你們怎麼有這俗語，說，日子遲延，一切異象都落空呢？
refs.text_en: Son of man, what is this proverb that you all have concerning the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged and every vision fails?

refs.text_gb: 并且要以我们主的恒忍为得救的机会，就像我们所亲爱的弟兄保罗，照着所赐给他的智慧，也写了信给你们；
refs.text_big5: 並且要以我們主的恆忍為得救的機會，就像我們所親愛的弟兄保羅，照著所賜給他的智慧，也寫了信給你們；
refs.text_en: And count the long-suffering of our Lord to be salvation, even as also our beloved brother Paul, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

refs.text_gb: 借着这些水，当时的世界被水淹没，就毁灭了；
refs.text_big5: 藉著這些水，當時的世界被水淹沒，就毀滅了；
refs.text_en: Through which the world then, being flooded with water, perished.

refs.text_gb: 祂愿意万人得救，并且完全认识真理；
refs.text_big5: 祂願意萬人得救，並且完全認識真理；
refs.text_en: Who desires all men to be saved and to come to the full knowledge of the truth.

refs.text_gb: 所以要回想你是从那里坠落的，并要悔改，行起初所行的。不然，我就要临到你那里；你若不悔改，我就把你的灯台从原处挪去。
refs.text_big5: 所以要回想你是從那裏墜落的，並要悔改，行起初所行的。不然，我就要臨到你那裏；你若不悔改，我就把你的燈臺從原處挪去。
refs.text_en: Remember therefore where you have fallen from and repent and do the first works; but if not, I am coming to you and will remove your lampstand out of its place, unless you repent.

refs.text_gb: 所以你要悔改；不然，我就快临到你那里，用我口中的剑攻击他们。
refs.text_big5: 所以你要悔改；不然，我就快臨到你那裏，用我口中的劍攻擊他們。
refs.text_en: Repent therefore; but if not, I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war with them with the sword of My mouth.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，我要叫她卧病在床，那些与她行淫的人，若不为她所行的悔改，我也要叫他们受大患难。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，我要叫她臥病在床，那些與她行淫的人，若不為她所行的悔改，我也要叫他們受大患難。
refs.text_en: Behold, I cast her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her, into great tribulation, unless they repent of her works;

refs.text_gb: 所以要回想你是怎样领受，怎样听见的，又要遵守，并要悔改。若不儆醒，我必临到你那里如同贼一样。我几时临到，你也绝不能知道。
refs.text_big5: 所以要回想你是怎樣領受，怎樣聽見的，又要遵守，並要悔改。若不儆醒，我必臨到你那裏如同賊一樣。我幾時臨到，你也絕不能知道。
refs.text_en: Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and keep it and repent. If therefore you will not watch, I will come as a thief, and you shall by no means know at what hour I will come upon you.

refs.text_gb: 凡我所爱的，我就责备管教；所以你要发热心，也要悔改。
refs.text_big5: 凡我所愛的，我就責備管教；所以你要發熱心，也要悔改。
refs.text_en: As many as I love I rebuke and discipline; be zealous therefore and repent.

refs.text_gb: 主耶和华说，我岂是喜悦恶人死亡么？不是喜悦他回头离开他的行径，而得存活么？
refs.text_big5: 主耶和華說，我豈是喜悅惡人死亡麼？不是喜悅他回頭離開他的行徑，而得存活麼？
refs.text_en: Do I take pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord Jehovah, and not in his turning away from his ways that he may live?

refs.text_gb: 主耶和华说，我不喜悦那死人之死，所以你们当回头而存活。
refs.text_big5: 主耶和華說，我不喜悅那死人之死，所以你們當回頭而存活。
refs.text_en: For I take no pleasure in the death of him who dies, declares the Lord Jehovah; therefore turn and live.

refs.text_gb: 你要对他们说，主耶和华说，我指着我的生存起誓，我断不喜悦恶人死亡，唯喜悦恶人转离他的行径而活。以色列家啊，你们转离，转离邪恶的行径吧，何必死亡呢？
refs.text_big5: 你要對他們說，主耶和華說，我指著我的生存起誓，我斷不喜悅惡人死亡，惟喜悅惡人轉離他的行徑而活。以色列家阿，你們轉離，轉離邪惡的行徑罷，何必死亡呢？
refs.text_en: Say to them, As I live, declares the Lord Jehovah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn away from his way and live. Turn away, turn away from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Israel?

verses.text_gb: 只是主[Fn1]的日[Cra]子要像贼[Crb]一样来[Fn2]到；在那[Fn3]日，诸[Fn4][Crc]天必轰[Fn5]然一声的过去，所有的元[Fn6]素都要被焚烧而销[Fn7][Crd]化，地[Cre]和其上的工[Fn8]程也都要烧尽了。
verses.text_big5: 只是主[Fn1]的日[Cra]子要像賊[Crb]一樣來[Fn2]到；在那[Fn3]日，諸[Fn4][Crc]天必轟[Fn5]然一聲的過去，所有的元[Fn6]素都要被焚燒而銷[Fn7][Crd]化，地[Cre]和其上的工[Fn8]程也都要燒盡了。
verses.text_en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the elements, burning with intense heat, will be dissolved, and the earth and the works in it will be burned up.
verses.text_gb_plain: 只是主的日子要像贼一样来到；在那日，诸天必轰然一声的过去，所有的元素都要被焚烧而销化，地和其上的工程也都要烧尽了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 只是主的日子要像賊一樣來到；在那日，諸天必轟然一聲的過去，所有的元素都要被焚燒而銷化，地和其上的工程也都要燒盡了。

footnotes.zh: 多半用在神行政审判(帖前五2与注1)的意义上。
footnotes.zh_big5: 多半用在神行政審判（帖前五2與註1）的意義上。
footnotes.en: 3:10 1 day Mainly in the sense of judgment (1 Thes. 5:2 and note 1 Thes. 5:2 2 ) for God's government.

footnotes.zh: 主审判的日子(帖前五3～4)，要在千年国以前来到(启十八1，十九11，二十4～6)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主審判的日子，（帖前五3～4，）要在千年國以前來到。（啟十八1，十九11，二十4～6。）
footnotes.en: 3:10 2 come The day of the Lord for His judgment (1 Thes. 5:3-4) will come before the millennium (Rev. 18:1; 19:11; 20:4-6).

footnotes.zh: 指主的日子。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指主的日子。
footnotes.en: 3:10 3 which Referring to the day of the Lord.

footnotes.zh: 这要在千年国以后发生(启二十7，11)。这又指明彼得越过了千年国的一千年(见7注5)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這要在千年國以後發生。（啟二十7，11。）這又指明彼得越過了千年國的一千年。（見7註5。）
footnotes.en: 3:10 4 heavens This will take place after the millennium (Rev. 20:7, 11). This indicates again that Peter skipped over the one thousand years of the millennium (see note 2 Pet. 3:7 4 ).

footnotes.zh: 即冲击的响声或闹声，也许是宣告宇宙中由旧变新的大转变。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即衝擊的響聲或鬧聲，也許是宣告宇宙中由舊變新的大轉變。
footnotes.en: 3:10 5 roar I.e., a rushing sound or noise. It may be a proclamation of a great change in the universe from the old to the new.

footnotes.zh: 即组成诸天的物质元素。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即組成諸天的物質元素。
footnotes.en: 3:10 6 elements The physical elements that compose the heavens.

footnotes.zh: 要将“销化”并“烧尽，”与来一12的“卷起来、”“改变，”启二十11的“逃遁、”“再无可见之处，”并启二一1的“过去”比较。将诸天和地焚烧而销化，乃是神用以将诸天和地卷起，将其除去，使其由旧变新的过程(13，启二一1)。这是神在祂的行政里，对受造之物末了、终结的对付。在神这末了的对付里，一切物质的东西都要过去，惟有祂永远的话要永远长存(太二四35，彼前一25)。不论物质的宇宙有何改变，神预言的话总要存留，并要在祂命定的时候得着应验，以成就祂永远的定旨。
footnotes.en: 3:10 7 burned Compare dissolved and burned up with roll them up and changed in Heb. 1:12, fled away and no place was found for them in Rev. 20:11, and passed away in Rev. 21:1. The burning with intense heat to dissolve the heavens and the earth is the procedure God will use to roll up the heavens and the earth and put them away that they may be changed from the old to the new (v. 13; Rev. 21:1). This will be God's final and consummate dealing with His creation in His government. In God's final dealing all the material things will pass away, but His eternal word will abide forever (Matt. 24:35; 1 Pet. 1:25). The word of His prophecy will remain and be fulfilled at His appointed time for the accomplishing of His eternal will, regardless of the change that will occur in the physical universe.

footnotes.zh: 也许兼指神自然的工程和人人为的工程。
footnotes.zh_big5: 也許兼指神自然的工程和人人為的工程。
footnotes.en: 3:10 8 works This may refer to both God's works of nature and man's works of art.

refs.text_gb: 祂也必坚固你们到底，使你们在我们主耶稣基督的日子无可指责。
refs.text_big5: 祂也必堅固你們到底，使你們在我們主耶穌基督的日子無可指責。
refs.text_en: Who will also confirm you until the end unreprovable in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

refs.text_gb: 正如你们已经有几分明白我们：我们乃是你们的夸耀，好像在我们主耶稣的日子，你们也是我们的夸耀一样。
refs.text_big5: 正如你們已經有幾分明白我們：我們乃是你們的誇耀，好像在我們主耶穌的日子，你們也是我們的誇耀一樣。
refs.text_en: Even as also you know us in part, that we are your boast, just as you also are ours in the day of our Lord Jesus.

refs.text_gb: 我深信那在你们里面开始了善工的，必完成这工，直到基督耶稣的日子。
refs.text_big5: 我深信那在你們裏面開始了善工的，必完成這工，直到基督耶穌的日子。
refs.text_en: Being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun in you a good work will complete it until the day of Christ Jesus;

refs.text_gb: 使你们能鉴赏那更美、不同的事，好叫你们纯诚无过，直到基督的日子，
refs.text_big5: 使你們能鑑賞那更美、不同的事，好叫你們純誠無過，直到基督的日子，
refs.text_en: So that you may approve by testing the things which differ and are more excellent, that you may be pure and without offense unto the day of Christ,

refs.text_gb: 将生命的话表明出来，叫我在基督的日子，好夸我没有空跑，也没有徒劳。
refs.text_big5: 將生命的話表明出來，叫我在基督的日子，好誇我沒有空跑，也沒有徒勞。
refs.text_en: Holding forth the word of life, so that I may have a boast in the day of Christ that I did not run in vain nor labor in vain.

refs.text_gb: 为这缘故，我也受这些苦难；然而我不以为耻，因为知道我所信的是谁，也深信祂能保守我所托付的，直到那日。
refs.text_big5: 為這緣故，我也受這些苦難；然而我不以為恥，因為知道我所信的是誰，也深信祂能保守我所託付的，直到那日。
refs.text_en: For which cause also I suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to guard my deposit unto that day.

refs.text_gb: 愿主使他在那日从主得着怜悯。他在以弗所怎样多方的服事我，你知道得最清楚。
refs.text_big5: 願主使他在那日從主得著憐憫。他在以弗所怎樣多方的服事我，你知道得最清楚。
refs.text_en: May the Lord grant him to find mercy from the Lord in that day. And in how many things he served me in Ephesus, you know best.

refs.text_gb: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是主，那公义的审判者，在那日要赏赐我的；不但赏赐我，也赏赐凡爱祂显现的人。
refs.text_big5: 從此以後，有公義的冠冕為我存留，就是主，那公義的審判者，在那日要賞賜我的；不但賞賜我，也賞賜凡愛祂顯現的人。
refs.text_en: Henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, with which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will recompense me in that day, and not only me but also all those who have loved His appearing.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要知道，家主若晓得贼在几更天要来，他就必儆醒，不容他的房屋被人挖透。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要知道，家主若曉得賊在幾更天要來，他就必儆醒，不容他的房屋被人挖透。
refs.text_en: But know this, that if the householder had known in which watch the thief was coming, he would have watched and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

refs.text_gb: 因为你们自己明确晓得，主的日子来到，好像夜间的贼一样。
refs.text_big5: 因為你們自己明確曉得，主的日子來到，好像夜間的賊一樣。
refs.text_en: For you yourselves know perfectly well that like a thief in the night, so the day of the Lord comes.

refs.text_gb: 所以要回想你是怎样领受，怎样听见的，又要遵守，并要悔改。若不儆醒，我必临到你那里如同贼一样。我几时临到，你也绝不能知道。
refs.text_big5: 所以要回想你是怎樣領受，怎樣聽見的，又要遵守，並要悔改。若不儆醒，我必臨到你那裏如同賊一樣。我幾時臨到，你也絕不能知道。
refs.text_en: Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and keep it and repent. If therefore you will not watch, I will come as a thief, and you shall by no means know at what hour I will come upon you.

refs.text_gb: （看哪，我来像贼一样。那儆醒、看守自己衣服，免得赤身而行，叫人见他羞耻的，有福了。）
refs.text_big5: （看哪，我來像賊一樣。那儆醒、看守自己衣服，免得赤身而行，叫人見他羞恥的，有福了。）
refs.text_en: (Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he who watches and keeps his garments that he may not walk naked and they see his shame.)
